description: This file is a server-side route handler for managing account data in a SvelteKit application. It includes a load function that fetches and processes account data from a Django REST API, as well as multiple actions for creating, updating, activating, deactivating, and deleting accounts. The code integrates with the API through imported helper functions and handles various account-related operations with detailed data transformation and filtering logic.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches account data from the API, applies filters and pagination, transforms API data into the application's format, and prepares data for rendering in the frontend.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of new account entries by submitting form data to the API.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing account with new form data via the API.

methods.name: deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates (soft deletes) an account by setting its 'is_active' flag to false.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Re-activates an account by setting its 'is_active' flag to true.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an account entry from the API.
